name: The Best Pizza Dough
desc: Same-day olive oil pizza dough stirred in one bowl with instant yeast, risen 30 minutes, and baked as one 12-inch pizza.

source.title: The Best Pizza Dough Recipe
source.evidence: Same title, identical ingredient list and amounts (2 to 2 1/3 cups flour, 1 packet instant yeast, 1 1/2 tsp sugar, 3/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3/4 cup warm water) and step text copied from the page.

ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/3 cups (250 to 295 g) all-purpose or bread flour, divided
1/8 to 1/4 tsp garlic powder and/or dried basil, optional
2 tbsp olive oil, plus about 2 tbsp more for the bowl and crust
ingredients.note: plus about 2 tbsp more for the bowl and crust

steps: Stir 1 cup (125 g) of the flour, the yeast, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl, plus the garlic powder and basil if using.
Add the 2 tbsp olive oil and the warm water and stir very well with a wooden spoon.

Stir in another 1 cup (125 g) flour a little at a time, then up to 1/3 cup more as needed, until the dough forms a cohesive, elastic ball that pulls away from the sides of the bowl. It should be slightly sticky but manageable.
Drizzle a second large bowl generously with olive oil and brush it up the sides.
With lightly floured hands, shape the dough into a ball, put it in the oiled bowl, and roll it around to coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and set in a warm place.
Let rise until doubled, about 30 min. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425°F.
Punch the dough down gently, turn it onto a lightly floured surface, and knead 3-5 times until smooth.
Shape with your hands or a rolling pin into a 12-inch circle. Move it to a parchment-lined pizza pan and pinch or fold the edge to form a crust.
Brush the whole surface, crust included, with about 1 tbsp olive oil. Prick the center all over with a fork so it does not bubble up.
Add toppings and bake until the crust and toppings are golden brown, 13-15 min. Slice and serve.

references.title: The Best Pizza Dough Recipe
